offence_note: Two firearm robberies, failing to stop for police, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: I think the denunciatory, deterrent and rehabilitative objectives of sentencing will be met by a term of imprisonment of 4 years 9 months.

offence_note: Sexual interference of two girls and making child pornography
sentence_quote: On Count 1 of the Indictment, the sexual interference of L.B. and N.G., I sentence you to three years and six months' imprisonment.
note: Count 2 one year consecutive; global 4y6m; s.743.2 order forwarding reports; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking of cocaine and fentanyl
sentence_quote: on each of Counts 1 and 2 on the indictment I sentence you to a term of imprisonment of four years, to be served concurrently.
note: Co-accused McMillan sentenced separately; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, two assaults with weapon, dangerous driving
sentence_quote: For the offence of aggravated assault, I sentence you to a period of incarceration of one year.
note: Concurrent terms; probation includes curfew; driving prohibition declined.

offence_note: Robbery with firearm, confinement, weapon possession, break and enter
co_offenders: Co-accused (gun carrier) sentenced separately, not shown
sentence_quote: the net result of which will be that the sentence imposed will be a global sentence of three years as opposed to four years.
note: Unclear whether 3y global is before or after the roughly three years credit; co-accused not sentenced here.

offence_note: Sexual assault and sexual exploitation by a high school teacher
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to the appellant to appeal his sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: 17-month global: 14 months exploitation plus 3 months consecutive for sexual assault.

offence_note: Loaded restricted handgun, removed serial number, concealed weapon
sentence_quote: we would grant leave to appeal sentence and at this point, substitute a sentence of time served to be followed by two years probation on the terms and conditions imposed by the trial judge.
note: Crown appeal; illegal 12-month conditional sentence replaced by time served plus probation.

offence_note: Aggravated assault with a machete, racially motivated
sentence_quote: The appellant received a reformatory sentence of two years less one day.
note: Court calls the crime racially motivated; conviction appeal also dismissed.

offence_note: Driving offence with lengthy driving prohibition; details not shown
sentence_quote: the driving suspension is reduced from ten years to eight years.
note: Offence and jail term not shown; voluntary abstention from driving credited.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon (broom handle) on eight-year-old son
sentence_quote: the appeal against sentence is dismissed and the sentence imposed at trial is affirmed.
note: Crown sentence appeal dismissed; conditional discharge stands; threat count stayed.

offence_note: Counselling to commit murder (murder conviction set aside)
sentence_quote: I would also grant leave to appeal sentence for counselling to commit murder, allow the appeal, and reduce the sentence to time served.
note: Second degree murder conviction quashed, new trial ordered; counselling sentence cut from 10 years.
